title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Drown, so you may breathe again." —Atraxa
"Behold your inevitable defeat." —Elesh Norn
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned." —Monument inscription
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in." —Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
"Where once there was complacence, Sheoldred brought ambition, and soon the will of Yawgmoth reigned." —Monument inscription
"It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."
For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain." —Sheoldred
"Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."
The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began." —Monument inscription
Once he fought to save Mirrodin. Now he fights to remake it.
Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.
"This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip." —Melira
"Ah, my old friends. Have you decided at last to stop clinging to the past and join me in the grand pursuit of perfection?"
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside." —Koth
"Lock the door and eat the key." —Vraan, Executioner Thane
It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.
Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.
Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.
Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.
As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.
Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.
Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.
